The decision tree algorithm, one of the most common algorithms in practice, is a predictive model. Its users don’t need to be technical, as it is easy to interpret and explain. Decision tree is an algorithm that allows data sets to be split into smaller data sets, and consists of internal nodes that determines the split criteria and leaf nodes where the results are represented.
